Language of the Heart (Softcover)

This book—our most popular—features all of AA cofounder Bill W.’s writings in Grapevine. Bill was Grapevine’s most prolific contributor, writing more than 150 articles from 1944 to 1970. The book contains Bill’s first thoughts about AA’s Twelve Traditions, his battles with depression and spiritual pride, memories of an all-night drinking spree with his dear friend Ebby and a vivid description of how he came to organize the Twelve Steps of AA. Great for meetings and AA history buffs. (406 pages).
